description:
Reproduced 2026-09-14 at main f26264572:

    def f(n, <<x::binary-size(n), _rest::binary>>), do: x

fz2 interp: entry dispatch pin has no runtime argument operand. The size names another parameter, so the pattern builder registers a pin (pattern.rs:825, BitstringFieldSize::Pinned) that dispatch reads at match time (ir_interp/dispatch_exec.rs:818, jobs/native.rs:3551), yet required_dispatch_input_ordinals matches Region::Bitstring(_) => {} (artifact.rs:1158-1164) and keying's mask never looks inside a bitstring shape, so n is not required and the interpreter is handed nil for it. fz-5xp.54 fixed the case where the size is bound by an EARLIER FIELD of the same bitstring (00311_binary_variable_size); the cross-parameter case is untested.

Closed by construction when the graph builder charges a bitstring shape's pinned sizes as it adds the node. This ticket's commit adds fixtures2/behavior/bitstring_pinned_size (three doors, oracle twin).
title: A pinned bitstring size in a clause head is required by no scanner; interp refuses the call
